name: Meeting Prep & Follow-up
tagline: A pre-meeting brief before you walk in, a drafted follow-up email when it ends.
description: Ahead of each meeting on your calendar a short brief arrives, so you show up already knowing who is involved and what the session is about. Once it is over, the follow-up email gets written for you and waits for review before anything is sent. Together they cover the admin that usually eats the time around meetings.
author: cu30rry_
